content.en: Choose a Question Master. They announce a category, write one shared title on all but one card, write X on the last, shuffle, and deal to artists. The X holder is the fake.
content.zh: 选出题者；他宣布类别，在除一张外的所有卡上写同一题目，最后一张写 X，洗混暗发给艺术家。拿 X 者是伪艺术家。

content.en: Each artist adds one continuous line, then passes clockwise. Complete two circuits. Give a clue, but do not make the title obvious to the fake.
content.zh: 每位艺术家画一条连续线后顺时针传递，共两圈。给真艺术家提示，但别让伪艺术家轻易猜题。

alt.en: Each artist adds one line to the shared drawing
alt.zh: 每位艺术家给共同画作添一笔

content.en: QM counts down. Everyone points at a suspect. If the fake has the most votes, they reveal and get one exact-title guess.
content.zh: QM 倒数后，所有人同时指认。伪艺术家最高票时亮明身份，并有一次准确猜题机会。

alt.en: Vote outcome determines whether the fake gets a title guess
alt.zh: 投票结果决定伪艺术家是否猜题

content.en: Escaped fake, or caught fake who guesses right: fake + QM get 2 each. Caught fake who guesses wrong: every real artist gets 1. Pass QM left; first to 5 wins.
content.zh: 伪艺术家逃脱，或被抓但猜对：伪艺术家和 QM 各得 2 分。被抓且猜错：每位真艺术家各得 1 分。QM 向左轮换，先到 5 分获胜。
